identity: Level datasets include levelIdentities with levelId, instanceId, seed, and generationConfig. Training examples include instanceId and generationConfig metadata.
currentGenerator: Level metadata and training-example metadata preserve current preset, strength, temporal variability, seed, stats, and generated current frames.
missionRules: Training example metadata preserves normalized endCondition and sampling configs when a mission is provided.
priorityTargets: Generated levels may include layers.priorityTargets; level datasets preserve those temporal target frames, and solver-packet datasets include normalized priorityTargets for external planners.
connectivity: Generated level metadata may include deployment connectivity validation, repair method, reachable navigable ratio, ROI reachability, and recovery reachability.
stochasticFields: expected vs realized summary when result metadata is included
notes: Readable schema-like documentation; validation is lightweight/manual. Training examples export as JSONL where each line contains input level/mission data, nullable target.plan, and metadata.
